description: Organize a meeting from one of your inboxes: one real calendar invitation to every attendee (at most 50), which their calendars show and answer as usual. Their answers come back as calendar.response.received and in get_event. Give end or duration_minutes (default 30). Only invite people the user asked you to; every send check and limit applies. With draft: true the invitation waits for a person to approve it, and the meeting exists once it is sent (event is null until then). Needs calendar:write and messages:send; with draft: true, drafts:write instead (a key that may write drafts but not send must pass draft: true). If a call answers calendar_not_enabled, Meetings is turned off for this workspace or server: tell the user.

all_day.description: An all-day meeting: start (and end) are dates.

attendees.description: Who to invite (1-50 people; the inbox itself is left out).

email.description: Email address of the person to invite.

name.description: Their name, shown in the invite.

draft.description: true: save it as a draft for a person to approve instead of sending it. Nothing goes out, and the meeting changes only when someone sends the draft. Needs drafts:write instead of messages:send. Use it when the user wants to check first, or when this key may not send.

duration_minutes.description: Length in minutes, instead of end (default 30).

end.description: End (for an all-day meeting, the day after the last day): ISO 8601 with an offset ("2026-11-10T15:00:00Z"), or a date ("2026-11-10") for an all-day meeting.

inbox_id.description: Inbox that organizes the meeting (its id).

message.description: A short note above the meeting details in the email.

rrule.description: A repeating series as an RRULE, e.g. "FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TU;COUNT=6" (FREQ DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY or YEARLY; at most 500 occurrences).

start.description: Start: ISO 8601 with an offset ("2026-11-10T15:00:00Z"), or a date ("2026-11-10") for an all-day meeting.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone the email words the time in, e.g. "Europe/Paris". A series is sent in it, so it keeps its local time when the clocks change; calendars show each meeting in their own zone.

name: create_meeting
title: Create meeting
